note: PDR drive band spacing is .200″ (recommend two drive bands in the case neck for concentricity) Tip length is .143″. Recommended use: Big Game Hunting. Form factor= .901. The product page also says: "This pure copper 30 caliber Hammer HBC™ is slick and fast. Designed to be fully stable in a 1-8.5″ twist barrel or faster this bullet will be excellent in many or the modern 30 caliber rifles and custom rifles with fast twist. At our 4200′ elevation a 30-06 with a muzzle vel of 2800 fps will carry 1800 fps to 850y. Just think what it would do in a 300 Ultra Mag. The Hammer HBC™ is designed to maximize ballistic coefficient for the bullet weight. Make sure the bullet specifications will work in your cartridge and rifle system. May require single feeding." The product page also says: "AT THIS TIME TIPS ARE CONSUMER INSTALLED" The product page also says: "TIPPING BLOCK INCLUDED WITH EACH ORDER"
